hints.content:
###Finding the area of the whole circle

$\begin{align}
\blueE{\text{Area}_{\text{circle}}} &= \pi \maroonD{r}^2\\\\
&=\pi (\maroonD{4})^2\\\\
&=\blueE{16\pi}
\end{align}$

The area of the whole circle is $\blueE{16\pi\,\text{cm}^2}$.

###Solving for the area of the sector

Let's use $\goldE{A_\text{s}}$ to represent the area of the sector.

$\begin{align}
\dfrac{ \purpleD{135}}{360}&=\dfrac{\goldE{A_{\text{s}}}}{\blueE{16\pi}}\\\\
\blueE{16\pi} \cdot\dfrac{ \purpleD{135}}{360}&=\dfrac{\goldE{A_{\text{s}}}}{\cancel{\blueE{16\pi}}}\cdot \cancel{\blueE{16\pi}}\\\\
\goldE{6\pi}&=\goldE{A_{\text{s}}}
\end{align}$

###Solution

The area of the sector is $6\pi\,\text{cm}^2$.
